title: Create Files collection
description: File: src/collections/Files.ts (NEW). Fields: user (relationship to users), filename (text), mimeType (text), filesize (number), geminiDocumentId (text), status (select: pending/indexing/ready/error). Access: user can only see their own files.

title: Chat page
description: File: src/app/(frontend)/(app)/chat/[id]/page.tsx. Using AI Elements: Conversation, ConversationContent, Message, MessageContent, MessageResponse (streaming), PromptInput, PromptInputTextarea, PromptInputSubmit, Sources (citations), Tool (file search display). Use useChat hook with /api/chat endpoint.

title: File upload API route
description: File: src/app/api/files/upload/route.ts. Steps: 1. Auth check 2. Parse multipart form 3. Create Files record (status: pending) 4. Upload to Gemini FileSearchStore 5. Update Files record (status: ready, geminiDocumentId). Handle errors, set status to error with message.

title: File delete API route
description: File: src/app/api/files/[id]/route.ts. DELETE handler: Auth check, remove from Gemini FileSearchStore, delete Files record from PayloadCMS.

title: Create Chats collection
description: File: src/collections/Chats.ts (NEW). Fields: user (relationship), title (text), createdAt, updatedAt. Access: user can only see their own chats.

title: Create Gemini client lib
description: File: src/lib/gemini.ts. Create: getGeminiClient() singleton, createFileSearchStore(displayName), uploadToStore(storeId, file, filename), deleteFromStore(storeId, documentId). Use @google/genai SDK.

title: Create Messages collection
description: File: src/collections/Messages.ts (NEW). Fields: chat (relationship to chats), role (select: user/assistant), content (textarea), sources (array of filename/snippet), createdAt. Access: user can only see messages from their own chats. Separate collection for scalability.

title: Register page
description: File: src/app/(frontend)/(auth)/register/page.tsx. Email/password registration form + Google OAuth button. Use PayloadAuth endpoints. On success: creates user, triggers afterChange hook to create Gemini FileSearchStore.

title: Files sidebar component
description: File: src/components/files-sidebar.tsx. Using @diceui/file-upload: FileUploadDropzone, FileUploadList, FileUploadItem, FileUploadItemProgress, FileUploadItemDelete. Custom status indicators (pending/indexing/ready/error). Collapse/expand toggle. Always accessible while chatting.

title: Add shadcn + DiceUI components
description: Run: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add form input label tabs avatar dropdown-menu && pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @diceui/file-upload. DiceUI file-upload for dropzone with progress indicators.

title: Configure PayloadAuth
description: File: src/payload.config.ts. Add payloadBetterAuth plugin. Enable email/password + Google OAuth. See https://www.payloadauth.com/ for docs.
close_reason: @payload-auth/better-auth-plugin is deprecated and incompatible with Payload 3.70. Need alternative approach - using native Payload auth for now.

title: App layout + sidebars
description: File: src/app/(frontend)/(app)/layout.tsx. Auth check via payload.auth(), redirect to /login if not authenticated. Left sidebar: chats list, new chat button, user menu. Right sidebar (collapsible): Files panel placeholder (uses files-sidebar.tsx component).

title: Chat streaming API route
description: File: src/app/api/chat/route.ts. Use Vercel AI SDK streamText() with google('gemini-2.5-flash'). Pass user's fileSearchStoreId to fileSearch tool. onFinish: persist assistant message to Messages collection. Auto-generate chat title from first message using LLM.

title: Dashboard page
description: File: src/app/(frontend)/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx. Show: recent chats list, file stats (count, status breakdown), quick actions (new chat, upload files).

title: Modify Users collection
description: File: src/collections/Users.ts. Add fileSearchStoreId field (text, readonly) for Gemini store. Add displayName field. Add afterChange hook: on create, call createFileSearchStore and update user with fileSearchStoreId.

title: Generate Payload types
description: Run: pnpm generate:types. After creating Files, Chats, Messages collections and updating Users.

title: Login page
description: File: src/app/(frontend)/(auth)/login/page.tsx. Email/password form + Google OAuth button. Use PayloadAuth endpoints. Redirect to /dashboard on success.
